name: Community Sponsored Ads Lite
author: adityajoshi1997

sections.description:
Community Sponsored Ads Lite adds lightweight image and link advertisements to a FluentCommunity feed.

The free edition is intentionally focused:

  • Administrators create and manage advertisements.
  • Each advertisement contains a title, brand name, description, image, and destination URL.
  • Ads can be enabled or disabled and scheduled with optional start and end dates.
  • Active ads rotate automatically between community posts.
  • No payment gateway, revenue tracking, visitor tracking, or video advertising is included.

The plugin does not send visitor or site data to IndraSys or any third-party service.

Privacy and external services

This plugin does not contact IndraSys or any third-party service from the public site or WordPress dashboard. It does not collect analytics, impressions, clicks, personal data, or telemetry.

Destination links and advertisement images are selected by the site administrator. When a visitor follows an advertisement link, the destination site’s own privacy policy applies.

Source code

All PHP, CSS, and JavaScript source code is included in the distributed plugin. The plugin has no build step and does not include minified or obfuscated code.

Pro edition

The optional Pro edition provides advertiser dashboards, payment gateways, analytics, video ads, affiliate advertisements, promoted posts, and additional placements. A single informational link is available at the bottom of the Lite settings screen.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate Community Sponsored Ads Lite.
  3. Open Sponsored Ads > Create Ad.
  4. Add an image advertisement and enable it.
  5. Adjust the feed frequency under Sponsored Ads > Settings.
sections.faq:
Does the Lite edition accept advertiser payments?

No. Lite is for advertisements created directly by a site administrator.

Does it support video advertisements?

No. Lite supports image advertisements only.

Does it track impressions, clicks, or revenue?

No. Lite does not collect advertisement analytics.

What happens if the Pro edition is active?

Lite and Pro use separate post types, settings, scripts, and CSS classes. Each edition can display the advertisements managed by that edition.

Does uninstalling remove my advertisements?

Only when “Delete Lite ads and settings when the plugin is uninstalled” is enabled in Settings.
